summary: PASS: omniclaude PR #2184 landed the cross-repo runner-route shim; this follow-up closes AC5, which the first pull request deliberately recorded as owed. The cross-repo route cost is now MEASURED rather than carried over: 155 seconds on omninode_infra run 35048508160, of which 69 were a dependency re-resolve caused by the run and the sync selecting different groups, and 34 were a post-job cache save on an ephemeral runner that nothing ever reads. Both are removed.
